items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on Magento and Adobe Commerce stores. Adobe released a fix for this flaw in APSB26-153.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (Zero-Day Exploited in Wild)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, codenamed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through PHP code injection via Magento's template system. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, deploying Rust backdoors and PHP web shells.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities including Account Takeover)
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation flaw (CVE-2026-71362). Exploitation attempts for CVE-2026-71362 have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution and Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without administrator access. Threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: This stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields. Successful exploitation can lead to session hijacking or unauthorized actions within the victim's account.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload with Dangerous Type (RCE)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows remote code execution due to unrestricted file upload with dangerous types. An attacker can exploit this to inject malicious scripts and achieve arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing six critical vulnerabilities. These critical flaws could lead to remote code execution, account takeover, admin login bypass, and payment fraud.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: This vulnerability in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary executable files to a Magento store. This flaw can lead to remote code execution without requiring login credentials.
